verdict.rationale: Browserbase documents running thousands of concurrent browser sessions, a URL-to-HTML/JSON/markdown fetch capability, and webhooks that report session status changes so you don't have to poll. That covers the scale and async pieces of the story. There is no documented batch-job or bulk-URL submission API, so the data engineer must fan out and orchestrate the URL list themselves. Missing for 10: a documented batch/bulk scrape endpoint or job queue, documented throughput limits and retry behaviour, and independent hands-on corroboration of scraping thousands of URLs.

support.subject: As a data-engineer, I can batch scrape thousands of URLs asynchronously

citations.quote: Spin up thousands of concurrent browser sessions and return answers immediately
Quickly fetch web context for your agent by converting any URL into HTML, JSON or markdown
Browserbase webhooks send an HTTP POST to an endpoint you own as soon as a subscribed event happens, so you don't have to poll the API for status changes.
